title: hieracium dasytrichum subsp. mesomorphum
intro: Hieracium dasytrichum subsp. mesomorphum, commonly known as Hawkweed, is a type of flowering plant in the dandelion family. This plant is used in herbal medicine for its health benefits, including reducing inflammation, improving digestion, and supporting immune function. The therapeutic actions of Hawkweed include antimicrobial, anti-inflammatory, and antioxidant properties, which may help to soothe skin conditions, wounds, and other ailments. The bioactive constituents of Hawkweed include sesquiterpene lactones, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
